what_happened.line: The committee voted to approve change orders 11, 12 and 13; the vote on change order 10 was not audible in the recording.
Change order 13 pays for a full enclosure of a wheelchair lift at the field stand, and its wording was corrected to say so.
The committee heard that a reconditioned piano is being bought within the furniture, fixtures and equipment budget, which is under budget.
Bids for moving and recycling were opened, with total cost expected under budget; the move is scheduled for June 13, with recycling to follow.
The committee reviewed monthly invoices and a photo walkthrough of the nearly complete building; the minutes were amended, and the vote on them was not audible.

why_it_matters: These change orders add cost to the school construction project, and the enclosure is justified by state fines for each day a lift is out of service and by costly repair visits.
The project is close to finished, with the furniture budget and move costs both reported as under budget, so late changes are what could still move the final cost.
